cited.quote: To address the evolving technological needs of the powerloom sector, which supports the livelihood of 5 lakhs powerloom weavers

rationale: C1 is G.O.(Ms) No. 07 dated 2026-01-19 implementing the New Integrated Textile Policy, with a dedicated powerloom section (modernisation subsidy, common facility centre). This is a dedicated GO for the powerloom sector, satisfying the directional commitment.

cited.quote: To address the evolving technological needs of the powerloom sector, which supports the livelihood of 5 lakhs powerloom weavers

rationale: C5 is the GO of 2026-01-19 launching the Powerloom Modernisation Scheme with capital subsidies and common facility centre assistance. C1 reports a Rs.50 crore Powerloom Modernization Scheme from 2025-26 but the GO is the dated official step.

cited.quote: To completely eradicate the menace of illicit liquor from the State of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C1-C3 show enforcement against illicit liquor, awareness campaigns and a penal amendment. C4/C5 are a warning-label rule amendment. None is an order outlining phased prohibition of alcohol; only related activity.

cited.quote: A district level Committee has been formed under the chairmanship of the District Collector

rationale: The only committees (C1, C3) plan awareness activities, not study or planning of prohibition. C2 covers enforcement, C4 an ethanol policy, C5 de-addiction centres. No committee for prohibition implementation is shown.

cited.quote: Distribution of Retro fitted two wheelers to differently abled persons by the Honourable Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu

rationale: C2 only shows retro-fitted two wheelers for differently abled persons generally, not motorised three-wheelers for students. C1 and C3 cover scholarships and other aids. No official step for three-wheelers for differently abled students is shown.

cited.quote: will bear the entire tuition fee of such students who secure admission to professional courses

rationale: C3 describes a first-graduate fee scheme started by the previous government and continuing; no GO or launch within this term is shown, and medical and agricultural courses are not covered. The pre-existing scheme gives no realisation step for this government.

For the Keeladi site museum, the Government has sanctioned 34 new posts

rationale: C1 shows the Keeladi museum at Sivagangai sanctioned in 2019-2020 (before this government) and built; C5 shows 34 posts sanctioned in 2021-22 with posts to be filled on completion. No extract shows the museum opened, and the identification with the promised museum is uncertain.
